reason: The value case does not survive a transfer check. (1) The idea's only honest evidence is exp11 (LOEO fine-tune, 6bba to 44b6: 0.8798 -> 0.8825). That gain is itself a node-multiplier artefact. The score/edge ratio goes 1.0248 -> 1.0298, i.e. T_pred/T_true 0.752 -> 0.702 (-6.6% nodes), while edge J falls 0.8585 -> 0.8570. At matched node count the fine-tune is -0.0015 on the embryo it did not fine-tune on (RESULTS.md exp11). So the claimed +0.003..+0.005 'honest upside after removing the node effect' has the wrong sign. (2) On the LB the node story fails to explain the loss. exp33 = 0.944 with +3.2% nodes; the corrected value is 0.944 + 0.003 = 0.947, the same as the base, so the gain is zero. The soup exp35 halves the shift, so the node story predicts ~0.9455, but it scored 0.943 (RESULTS.md probes 15/17; CONTEXT.md B18). B19 was also 'confirmed' negative by a public det-0.99 fork (0.942, CONTEXT.md B19). (3) The node shift changes sign with the embryo: +3.2% on the public/dummy clips (exp30), +5.6% on hold12 (exp06 t_pred 232k -> 245k), -6.6% on 44b6 after a 6bba-only fine-tune (exp11). A threshold matched on 4 dummy clips therefore cannot hold the multiplier on the private embryos (71%). The residual error is about +-3-5% nodes, i.e. +-0.003-0.005 of score, which is as large as the whole claimed gain. (4) The gate is inside the noise and biased. The seed-to-seed difference of the same recipe is 0.0073 on hold12 (exp16 vs exp03B), and per-video weight-swap effects are -0.037..+0.039 locally against 0.003 on the LB. Axis-flip TTA passed an unseen-embryo control (+0.019 on a scratch primary) and still scored -0.001 on the LB (B30). A single-seed +0.004 on 12 videos cannot separate the loss from noise. Worse, the pilkwang init saw ALL 199 videos, including the LOEO eval clips. PU masking removes most of the negative gradient, so the model stays closer to that memorising init and looks better on in-sample clips than the control does. The gate is therefore biased toward a false pass. (5) The other two components have tiny ceilings. The v2 dose-response puts de-quantisation (round vs floor) at <= +0.001..0.002, and the V1284 head already takes most of it. PU masking mainly raises peaks on unannotated nuclei: their edges are free, but the extra nodes cost multiplier. Annotated node recall is already 0.983 (BRIEF), and a_never FN are mostly 4-10 um z offsets or 44b6 under-segmentation, which the loss change does not target. (6) The primary swap forces a head recapture and retrain on shifted features. The x138 head is worth ~+0.004 of localisation (h_detector-retrain.json), and the last 199-video head retrain failed its kill test, so a loss of 0.001-0.004 is at least as likely as any detector gain. The idea's own central estimate is -0.001, with P(>0) ~0.3. Public LB noise is 0.003. Realistic public gain is below +0.002, and private is no better.
fix_if_any: Do not swap the primary for the 29 Sep deadline. The one salvageable form is a proposal-only copy. Train the PU-masked detector as a separate model whose peaks enter only x138's low-detection pool (readmit/gapfill, which are already gated), and leave the pilkwang primary, its UNet features, the V1284 head and the edge network untouched. That merges with the dense-proposal-detector-copy idea, removes the head recapture (-5.5 GPU-h) and the frozen-linker trap, and keeps node growth under readmit's gate. If anyone still wants to measure the loss change, three conditions are needed. (a) Initialise from an out-of-embryo model (friend_a_exp02_loeo20, 6bba-only scratch), not from pilkwang, so the eval embryo is truly unseen. (b) Use >= 2 seeds per arm and judge on edge J at matched Tpred/Ttrue on the lab (not adj, not 4 dummy clips), with a gate of >= +0.008. That is above sqrt(2) x 0.005 seed noise, required in both directions and on >= 8/12 videos. (c) Treat even a pass as post-deadline research: there is no LB-transfer precedent for any model-side lab win (B30, exp31, exp30/32).
realistic_public_gain: -0.003..+0.002 (central ~-0.001; guess anchored on exp33/exp35 = zero at matched nodes, exp11 matched-node edge J -0.0015, head-recapture risk -0.001..-0.004)
realistic_private_gain: -0.004..+0.002 (central ~-0.001; wider than public because the fine-tune's node shift changes sign across embryos, +3.2% / +5.6% / -6.6%, and the dummy-clip threshold match cannot control it on unseen embryos)
critical_path: Needs about 12 h of friend A's 5070 Ti, whose availability is uncertain: 4 LOEO fine-tunes + evals (~5 h), then a final all-199 fine-tune (1 h) and a 199-video head recapture (~5.5 h). Then H1-recipe head training (CPU), a 3 h agent patch + kernel build, and a dummy run on Kaggle vitalii (~40 min). Best case: gate 26 Sep 16:00 UTC, recapture done 27 Sep 02:00, kernel 08:00, submit ~10:00, scored ~20:00 27 Sep. Realistic: submit 28 Sep and score 28 Sep evening. It competes with H1/H2 for the same GPU, and the idea itself says to start only if friend A is idle. The probability of a scored probe before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC is ~0.3-0.4, and the probability that the probe is informative (|delta| > 0.003 noise) is lower still.
